title: Repository authentication
brief: The production or staging Application can no longer fetch its source. Read the repository connection error and compare the configured URL with the working repository entry.

checks.question: Which Application cannot fetch its source?
checks.hint: Filter by the environment in the briefing.
checks.why: The list identifies the affected release.

checks.question: Which repository transport is failing?
checks.hint: Read the URL and authentication failure in Conditions.
checks.why: Conditions show whether a failure is in repository access or rendered resources.

checks.question: Which transport does the working repository entry use?
checks.hint: Open Settings → Repositories and read the connected Gitea URL.
checks.why: The connected repository entry provides a known-good source to compare with the failing Application.

truth.cause: The Application uses an SSH repository URL without a deploy key
truth.fix: Restore the authenticated repository URL in the Application
